$comment: Card styles of the Botanical Herbarium set (Commander Vault capsule machine), written by art/machine-specs.mjs from career/machines/commander-vault.json: edit that file and re-run, not this one.
style: Nineteenth-century natural history botanical plate: fine sepia copperplate ink lines over translucent sage, moss and viridian watercolour washes on warm aged rag paper, gentle ochre accents.
rules: These are full-art pictures for playing cards: the client draws a small name plate over the top edge, mana symbols at the top right and power and toughness at the bottom right, so keep the main subject in the middle of the panel and the top 15% and bottom 15% calm and uncluttered (sky, ground, water, background texture), with nothing important in the corners. Each panel shows its own subject as one clear, readable scene, the same style and palette as its neighbours, as if the whole row were a matched, limited-edition art series.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: two freshly sprouted saplings sharing intertwined roots over dark fertile loam and a meandering forest brook
